'''''Anacamptis papilionacea''''', (formerly ''Orchis papilionacea''), commonly known as the '''pink butterfly orchid''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[orchid]] family [[Orchidaceae]].

== Distribution and habitat ==
The species is found in Southern Europe and Northern Africa ([[Spain]], [[Turkey]], [[Serbia]], [[Cyprus]], [[Lebanon]], [[Aegean Islands]], ...), and favors dry and stony ground.<ref name=Blamey>{{cite book |first1=Marjorie |last1=Blamey |first2=Christopher |last2 =Grey-Wilson |publisher=A&C Black |location=London |date=2005 |title=Wild flowers of the Mediterranean |isbn=0-7136-7015-0 }}</ref>{{rp|510}}
